title: Does spoken speech teach imagined speech? Leakage-controlled linear baselines on three public datasets (sEMG + EEG)
description: Reproducible linear baselines run before building a 16-channel EEG rig for imagined-speech repeatability. Tests whether a decoder trained on spoken (or silently articulated) speech reads imagined speech, on Gaddy 2020 (sEMG), Nieto 2022 and FEIS 2019 (EEG), with session/temporal-block validation and permutation nulls. Includes the observation that same-trial train/test splits produce an apparent spoken-to-imagined transfer that disappears under temporal-block splits.
